svg.text: Figure 20-2. Virtual Waiting Room, Event-Sharded Inventory Service, and Payment Saga.

g.text: Control Plane (Admission Pacing, Shard Directory & Lease Reclamation)
Controls crowd ingress rate · Maps events to shards · Reclaims expired holds
Data Plane (Admission Gate, Event-Sharded Inventory & Payment Saga)
Waiting room absorbs spike · Row-level CAS prevents double selling under contention

svg.text: Sharding inventory by event identifier keeps multi-seat holds inside a single
database transaction while the virtual waiting room caps concurrent load.
External card rails cannot join a local database transaction, so a durable
saga coordinates seat holds, payment capture, and compensating refunds.
